from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h=len(grid)
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        pat=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if not pat: continue
        n=len(pat)
        sources=[]
        for k,src in enumerate(grid):
            if k==i: continue
            sp=[j for j,v in enumerate(src) if v!=bg]
            if len(sp)<=n or 2*n < len(sp): continue
            if all(src[j]==row[j] for j in pat):
                sources.append((len(sp),k))
        if not sources: continue
        _,k=max(sources)
        for j,v in enumerate(grid[k]):
            if v!=bg and row[j]==bg: out[i][j]=1
    return out
